title: W01 to W11 Client Analytics Event Ingress

caller.authority: Public wire boundary, bounded input validation, anti-abuse and optional session principal resolution

callee.authority: Validated derived analytics ingestion into D1-05

headers.X-LuckRead-Correlation-Id: required; generated by W01 if absent or malformed
headers.X-LuckRead-Principal-User-Id: optional; resolved only by W01 through the existing W02 session-authority path

provenance.actorRule: W11 derives actorType and actorId/visitorId from the trusted principal header; the public body cannot set actor fields.
provenance.sourceWorker: W11 stamps W01 for client content telemetry. W03/W05 authoritative event producers remain distinct.

persistence.lateEvents: durable LATE status; excluded from live projection until explicit replay

invariants: Analytics measurements are derived data and never business source-of-truth records.
The client transport accepts allow-listed impression, reading and video measurements only; authoritative social event names are rejected.
W01 sends no end-user Authorization credential through the Service Binding.
The session ID is used to validate measurement shape but is not persisted by D1-05.
W03/W05/W07 authoritative mutations never wait for analytics ingestion.
The route is public only through W01; W11 has no public Worker route and the internal handler requires W01 transport provenance.
No Worker, D1, Queue, public Worker route or Payload Collection is created.
nonGoals: No social interaction mutation or counter update.
No new analytics batch operation; /analytics/batch remains discovery-only.
No D1-05 authority over content, social relationships, identity, entitlement or finance facts.
No remote deployment, migration application or route enablement in this change.
